data.narrative:
Deepnight is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Lucas Young and Thomas Li that has raised $5.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables spanning Series A and Seed rounds, with a broader universe of 10 total comparable companies (2 public, 8 private) including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $5.5M raised as a valuation proxy, applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier to derive an implied valuation of $14M. Peer-Median analysis examines four direct comparables in Defense & Security—Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yielding a median valuation of $700M with a range of $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects stage and maturity heterogeneity within the sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $12M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $357M. The wide spread reflects fundamental uncertainty around Deepnight's product maturity, commercial traction, and defensibility relative to the peer set. Stage-Progression suggests a conservative $14M floor based on capital deployed, while Peer-Median incorporates sector dynamics but carries significant estimation risk given the heterogeneity of comparable companies and limited visibility into Deepnight's operational performance.
